title: iHRIS 4.3.3 code list: registration_type
description: The `registration_type` code list as iHRIS 4.3.3 ships it by default: 2 codes from ihris-qualify/module/ihris-qualify. Each term's notation is the iHRIS record id and its label the record's `name`. The source gives no definitions, so every term is a candidate.
